title: What Is an Explainer Video? A Plain-English Guide (blog explainer)

brief.story: A clear explainer of the post.

slides.title: What Is an Explainer Video?
slides.notes: Ever been asked what an explainer video actually is? It's a short video that explains one thing clearly. Here's the plain-English version.

slides.title: Three features make an explainer
slides.notes: Every explainer answers one question and moves from problem to answer. Narration explains while visuals show. The goal is understanding, not advertising.

slides.title: Narrated slides are the shortest route
slides.notes: Animation and live action take serious effort. Narrated slides do the same job, and many organisations already explain their biggest ideas in decks.

slides.title: Follow a simple story
bullets: Situation, problem, answer, proof, next step
"Start a return from your order page."
slides.notes: A reliable shape is situation, problem, answer, proof, next step. Keep words and pictures matched, so when you say order page, viewers see it.

slides.title: Keep it short and accessible
bullets: Can't sum it up in one sentence? Split it
slides.notes: Every extra minute should earn its place. Add captions and readable text, so people watching with the sound off can still follow along.

slides.title: Turn your deck into an explainer
slides.notes: Your speaker notes become the narration. On Pro, a.i. directs the video, so a plain deck lands like a produced explainer. Try Basic first at powerpoint2vid.com.
